verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major graph-union defect. gen_graphs now treats each NULL graph map as contributing no label without erasing surviving sibling or subject/POM labels; emit_row drops a statement only when the combined graph set is empty and at least one declared map produced NULL. The corrected default-graph test now requires the row-2 predicate-object statement to survive through the subject map's rr:defaultGraph, and the focused regression test covers NULL on either side of the union plus mixed sibling graph maps. The implementation and tests consistently preserve the declared-versus-absent graph-map distinction, and no new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the diff.
